findings.text: The brief asked to `git rm` the August and September folders and replace them with stub `index.json` files. Instead, only the untracked pictures moved to E:, and every tracked record stayed. The reason is recorded as a `decision` line in task.jsonl with the alternative named: `git rm` would free 0 bytes of `.git`, hide the two months from SessionIndex, PastWork and FollowUp, and break old task URLs. That is a sound reason to depart from the brief, but the owner should see it called out in the owner note, not only in the log.

`Server/archive-sessions.mjs:160` deletes the untracked pictures from C: with `fs.unlinkSync`, which git cannot undo. The brief said "never `rm`". The risk is low: `--apply` first re-checks the sha1 of the archive copy and of the file, and the full backup from 15:53 also exists. Still, after this step the E: drive is the only live copy of 4,248 files, so the R2 second copy (the open question) matters more than the docs suggest.

The doc is named `ai/sessions/doc/picture-archive.md`, not the `archive.md` the brief asked for. The new name fits the narrower scope better, and every link points at it (`sessions/readme.md:20`, `sessions/doc/readme.md:12`), so this is fine.

The diff has no owner note (deliverable 5), no card report and no landing line yet. The last line of task.jsonl is the "Applied… commit, owner note, landing" log. The agent should check that these land before calling the task finished.

smoke.txt shows 6 FAILs on September pages: controls-study, layout-study, vocabulary-tags, imagine-generated, imagine-stream and paging. Their causes (a missing requirements.md, `screenshot?path=undefined`, a missing session.json) predate this task. `vocabulary-1280.png` is not in `2026/09/archive.jsonl` (grep count 0), so the archive did not cause these. But `merge.mjs` could refuse any later change that touches September, so the six should go to the follow-up list.

Simpler path: the first apply removed every picture, and two later `--undo --drawn` passes put 734 back (apply.txt). It would be simpler to run `drawn()` before deleting, which the final code already does (line 155). The extra passes only show up in the log, and nothing is wrong now.

The table row in `ai/doc/repo-size.md` still says "Archive old sessions out of the working tree", but only the pictures left. Rewording the row to "Archive old session pictures" would stop a reader from assuming the folders are gone.
